facts.text: Cloud Migration APIs v1.0 provide end-to-end automation for cloud migration setup, data movement, and progress tracking.
First step: POST request to setupCloudMigration endpoint with productId, sqlServerType, and SqlConnectionString.
For on-premises SQL Server sources, install Microsoft Integration Runtime using the runtimeKey from setup response.
Complete setup by posting to setupCloudMigration completeSetup endpoint after runtime configuration.
Mark companies for replication by patching cloudMigrationCompanies with replicate true, then run createCompaniesMarkedForReplication.
Start data replication by posting to cloudMigrationStatus runReplication endpoint.
Trigger data upgrade by posting to cloudMigrationStatus runDataUpgrade endpoint.
Final step: disable replication by posting to cloudMigrationStatus disableReplication endpoint.
